entries.title: John 10:1
segments: In truth I tell you, whoever does not go into the sheepfold through the door, but climbs up at some other place, that man is a thief and a robber;

entries.title: John 10:2
segments: But the man who goes in through the door is shepherd to the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:3
segments: For him the watchman opens the door; and the sheep listen to his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.

entries.title: John 10:4
segments: When he has brought them all out, he walks in front of them, and his sheep follow him, because they know his voice.

entries.title: John 10:5
segments: They will not follow a stranger, but will run away from him; because they do not know a stranger's voice."

entries.title: John 10:6
segments: This was the allegory that Jesus told them, but they did not understand of what he was speaking.

entries.title: John 10:7
segments: So he continued: "In truth I tell you, I am the Door for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:8
segments: All who came before me were thieves and robbers; but the sheep did not listen to them.

entries.title: John 10:9
segments: I am the Door; he who goes in through me will be safe, and he will go in and out and find pasture.

entries.title: John 10:10
segments: The thief comes only to steal, to kill, and to destroy; I have come that they may have Life, and may have it in greater fullness.

entries.title: John 10:11
segments: I am the Good Shepherd. The Good Shepherd lays down his life for his sheep.

entries.title: John 10:12
segments: The hired man who is not a shepherd, and who does not own the sheep, when he sees a wolf coming, leaves them and runs away; then the wolf seizes them, and scatters the flock.

entries.title: John 10:13
segments: He does this because he is only a hired man and does not care about the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:14
segments: I am the Good Shepherd; and I know my sheep, and my sheep know me--

entries.title: John 10:15
segments: Just as the Father knows me and I know the Father--and I lay down my life for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:16
segments: I have other sheep besides, which do not belong to this fold; I must lead them also, and they will listen to my voice; and they shall become one flock under 'one Shepherd.'

entries.title: John 10:17
segments: This is why the Father loves me, because I lay down my life- -to receive it again.

entries.title: John 10:18
segments: No one took it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to receive it again. This is the command which I received from my Father."

entries.title: John 10:19
segments: In consequence of these words a difference of opinion again arose among the Jews.

entries.title: John 10:20
segments: Many of them said: "He is possessed by a demon and is mad; why do you listen to him?"

entries.title: John 10:21
segments: Others said: "This is not the teaching of one who is possessed by a demon. Can a demon give sight to the blind?"

entries.title: John 10:22
segments: Soon after this the Festival of the Re-dedication was held at Jerusalem.

entries.title: John 10:23
segments: It was winter; and Jesus was walking in the Temple Courts, in the Colonnade of Solomon,

entries.title: John 10:24
segments: When the Jews gathered round him, and said: "How long are you going to keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us so frankly."

entries.title: John 10:25
segments: "I have told you so," replied Jesus, "and you do not believe me. The work that I am doing in my Father's name bears testimony to me.

entries.title: John 10:26
segments: But you do not believe me, because you are not of my flock.

entries.title: John 10:27
segments: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me;

entries.title: John 10:28
segments: And I give them Immortal Life, and they shall not be lost; nor shall any one snatch them out of my hands.

entries.title: John 10:29
segments: What my Father has entrusted to me is more than all else; and no one can snatch anything out of the Father's hands.

entries.title: John 10:30
segments: The Father and I are one."

entries.title: John 10:31
segments: The Jews again brought stones to throw at him;

entries.title: John 10:32
segments: And seeing this, Jesus said: "I have done before your eyes many good actions, inspired by the Father; for which of them would you stone me?"

entries.title: John 10:33
segments: "It is not for any good action that we would stone you," answered the Jews, "but for blasphemy; and because you, who are only a man, make yourself out to be God."

entries.title: John 10:34
segments: "Are there not," replied Jesus, "these words in your Law--'I said "Ye are gods"'?

entries.title: John 10:35
segments: If those to whom God's word were addressed were said to be 'gods'--and Scripture cannot be set aside--

entries.title: John 10:36
segments: Do you say of one whom the Father has consecrated and sent as his Messenger to the world 'You are blaspheming,' because I said 'I am God's Son'?

entries.title: John 10:37
segments: If I am not doing the work that my Father is doing, do not believe me;

entries.title: John 10:38
segments: If I am doing it, even though you do not believe me, believe what that work shows; so that you may understand, and understand more and more clearly, that the Father is in union with me, and I with the Father."

entries.title: John 10:39
segments: Upon this the Jews again sought to arrest him; but he escaped their hands.

entries.title: John 10:40
segments: Then Jesus again crossed the Jordan to the place where John used to baptize at first, and stayed there some time, during which many people came to see him.

entries.title: John 10:41
segments: "John gave no sign of his mission," they said; "but everything that he said about this man was true."

entries.title: John 10:42
segments: And many learned to believe in Jesus there.
